item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 15/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will bring showers to southern China today. Under the influence of the relatively dry continental airstream, the band of clouds will thin out gradually. The weather will be mainly fine over the region tomorrow. A southerly airstream is expected to bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong early next week. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. Hot with sunny intervals in the afternoon. Visibility relatively low in some areas.
